content.introduction: The S&P 500 is in a rising trend channel in the medium long term, indicating good market development, but it has broken a support level in the short term, signaling a potential short-term negative reaction. The index is approaching resistance at 7800 points, which may also give a negative reaction. However, a break upwards through 7800 points will be a positive signal. The RSI curve shows a falling trend, indicating a possible trend reversal downwards for the price. The index is overall assessed as technically neutral for the medium long term. The recommendation for one to six months is weak positive.
body:
S&P 500 is in a rising trend channel in the medium long term. This shows that investors over time have bought the index at higher prices and indicates good development for the market. However, the price has broken a support level in the short term and given a negative signal for the short term trading range. The index is approacing resistance at 7800 points, which may give a negative reaction. However, a break upwards through 7800 points will be a positive signal.
